args.code: (() => { const items = document.querySelectorAll('.sell-item, .crop-item, .shop-item'); let result = []; for (let item of items) { const text = item.textContent.trim(); if (text.length > 0 && text.length < 100) { result.push(text); } } if (result.length === 0) { const all = document.querySelectorAll('*'); let crops = []; for (let el of all) { const text = el.textContent.trim(); if ((text.includes('库存') || text.includes('出售') || text.includes('kg') || text.includes('斤')) && text.length < 80 && text.length > 5) { crops.push(text); } } return JSON.stringify(crops.slice(0, 30)); } return JSON.stringify(result.slice(0, 30)); })()
